name: Save the Villainess
source:
An otome isekai roleplaying game. Some people have pets. You now have a romance novel villainess. Guide your villainess through an animated visual novel with menacing manors, mysteries, (wo)men, and murder to see if you can… Save the Villainess.

Congratulations! You are now in possession of one (1) romance novel villainess! 

Unfortunately, neither you nor she remember the bad romance novel you are trapped in… or which character wants her dead.

Guide your amnesiac villainess through mysteries, menacing manors, and (wo)men who may be trying to murder her.

Meet with five suspiciously gorgeous characters and pursue romance, revenge, or revolution.

Can you find clues, fight off foes, calm angry furniture, and escape from eldritch horrors while solving the mystery of this world?
translation:
這是一款乙女向異世界角色扮演遊戲。別人養寵物，你養了一位戀愛小說裡的惡役千金。引導她走進這部動態視覺小說，在陰森的莊園、重重謎團、形跡可疑的男女和謀殺案之間周旋，看看你能不能……救下惡役千金。

恭喜！你現在擁有戀愛小說惡役千金一（1）位！

可惜，你和她都想不起你們究竟被困在哪本爛俗戀愛小說裡……更想不起哪個角色想要她的命。

帶著失憶的惡役千金解開謎題，穿過危機四伏的宅邸，與那些可能打算謀殺她的男男女女打交道。

五位美得可疑的角色等著與你見面。戀愛、復仇或革命，悉聽尊便。

你能邊追查這個世界的秘密，邊找出線索、擊退敵人、安撫發怒的家具，再從不可名狀的恐怖中逃生嗎？
